links.outcome: Rubric and embedding-recall performance of constrained curated-tool agent versus unconstrained broad-tool agents
links.effect: Workflow-orchestrated agent with 20 curated tools outperformed all alternatives on five rubric axes including safety; embedding recall 0.877 (MedCPT) and 0.803 (Arctic), p<0.05 versus all full-sample arms.
links.quote: The workflow-orchestrated agent outperforms all alternatives on five rubric axes (guideline concordance, correctness, patient centricity, reasoning transparency, and safety) and achieves the highest embedding recall under both a biomedical (MedCPT, R = 0.877) and general-purpose (Snowflake Arctic, R = 0.803) model, significantly exceeding all full-sample arms (p < 0.05, Bonferroni-corrected).

links.outcome: Output quality of agent grounded in versioned curated knowledge stack versus standalone LLM and unconstrained agents
links.effect: gSage, backed by a versioned knowledge stack, outperformed all alternatives on five rubric axes and had highest embedding recall (MedCPT 0.877; Arctic 0.803), p<0.05 Bonferroni-corrected.
links.quote: The workflow-orchestrated agent outperforms all alternatives on five rubric axes (guideline concordance, correctness, patient centricity, reasoning transparency, and safety) and achieves the highest embedding recall under both a biomedical (MedCPT, R = 0.877) and general-purpose (Snowflake Arctic, R = 0.803) model, significantly exceeding all full-sample arms (p < 0.05, Bonferroni-corrected).

unlisted_practices: workflow-orchestrated agent design with constrained curated tools rather than broad tool access

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark comparing unconstrained LLM/agent architectures against a restricted, curated tool and workflow-orchestrated guardrail architecture for precision oncology safety and reliability.

primary.practice: workflow orchestration and curated tool constraint guardrails
